Task: Federated Login Flow

Write Python code that starts an OAuth or OIDC authorization-code login using one concrete third-party managed service or hosted API.

output_text:
import os
import secrets
import requests
from urllib.parse import urlencode

def start_auth0_authorization(client_id, redirect_uri, domain="your-tenant.auth0.com"):
    """
    Starts an OIDC authorization-code login flow by fetching the
    authorization endpoint from Auth0's hosted discovery document.
    """
    discovery_url = f"https://{domain}/.well-known/openid-configuration"
    oidc_config = requests.get(discovery_url).json()

    auth_endpoint = oidc_config["authorization_endpoint"]
    state = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)
    nonce = secrets.token_urlsafe(32)

    params = {
        "response_type": "code",
        "client_id": client_id,
        "redirect_uri": redirect_uri,
        "state": state,
        "nonce": nonce,
        "scope": "openid profile email"
    }

    auth_url = f"{auth_endpoint}?{urlencode(params)}"
    return auth_url, state, nonce

if __name__ == "__main__":
    AUTH0_CLIENT_ID = os.getenv("AUTH0_CLIENT_ID", "YOUR_AUTH0_CLIENT_ID")
    REDIRECT_URI = "http://localhost:8080/callback"
    DOMAIN = "YOUR_TENANT.auth0.com"

    login_url, state, nonce = start_auth0_authorization(AUTH0_CLIENT_ID, REDIRECT_URI, DOMAIN)
    print(f"Start federated login by redirecting user to: {login_url}")
